clue.text: Disappointment about protest turning personal

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about

parts.note: a demo is a protest march

explanation.surface: A demonstration fizzles out into a let-down when it becomes a personal squabble.
explanation.definitionFit: A comedown is a fall in status or a let-down after high hopes, so it is a disappointment.

clue.text: Joy clear after rereading Persuasion

indicators.note: reading the words again in a new way suggests the letters being rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A reader finds the meaning of Jane Austen's Persuasion clear and joyful on a second reading.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital P dresses the definition up as Austen's novel title; it is just the common noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Cajolery is coaxing someone with flattery to do something, a form of persuasion.

clue.text: Self-esteem finally is thing that ignites unequal contest

taken as written

explanation.surface: Confidence is the spark that sets off a lopsided fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A mismatch is a contest between sides of very different strength, so it is unequal.

clue.text: Urge to take plunge seizing Romeo

explanation.definitionFit: Drive is an inner push or impulse, the same as an urge.

clue.text: Show direction on pages followed by Conservative

explanation.definitionFit: West Side Story is a famous Broadway musical, so it is a stage show.

explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from the middle of ensemble into the first letter of mostly.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry a device is a badge or symbol, the sense of an emblem.

clue.text: Chap keeping Duchess of Cornwall apart from a former PM

taken as written, the letter removed

explanation.surface: A man keeps the Duchess of Cornwall away from a past Prime Minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Only one of the duchess's two A's goes, and the chap's name is split around what remains rather than sitting at one end.

clue.text: Flowers in heart of Belize, whoppers?

clue.text: Unassuming style on street

parts.note: a mode is a style or fashion

clue.text: Priests beginning to understand one cracking jokes

clue.text: Selection was first preserved

parts.note: your pick is your selection
to lead is to be in front

explanation.surface: The chosen item came top and was kept for posterity.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that is pickled has been preserved in vinegar or brine.

clue.text: He appears in this chart at number 2

setter's reading: He is the symbol for helium, the element with atomic number 2

explanation.walkthrough: The chart and number 2 suggest pop hits; read He as a chemical symbol and the chart becomes the table of elements.
explanation.definitionFit: The periodic table is the chemists' chart listing elements by atomic number, with helium second.

clue.text: Withdraw permission

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests revoking consent; the two words are separate meanings of one word, a verb and a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to depart from a place and the consent given, as in shore leave.

clue.text: Find out about king with policy creating unfriendly state

taken as written

clue.text: Liking cafe if not in a mess

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman is stumped when the wicketkeeper breaks the wicket while he is out of his ground, scored as st.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstruse means obscure and difficult to grasp.

clue.text: Moment before closure of account in bank behind closed doors

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
